title: A cozy cemetery for the things you leave behind
author: taio_doio
selftext:
Hey everyone!  
After quite a few failed attempts, I’ve spent the last few months building **Necrothing**, a little cozy-spooky game about letting go.

While most habit trackers encourage us to do more and become better versions of ourselves, Necrothing takes a different approach: a tiny cemetery where you can bury old habits, failed plans, memories, or whatever deserves a goodbye. Sometimes with affection, sometimes with a bit of dark humour.

**I’m a designer, not a developer**, so yes, there’s been plenty of vibe coding involved! But also Blender (manually.. not via mcp eheh), hand sketches, moodboards, UX research, and lots of trial and error.  
AI made this possible, but it definitely didn’t solve everything (or maybe my prompting skills just suck :D.. I see a lot of “this super cool game has been done with one prompt and 20$” 🥲. Damn, not my case). Getting Three.js to run smoothly on mobile, in particular, required plenty of research, experimentation, and broken builds.

A small beta community of 20 people, both gamers and non-gamers, is currently helping me find bugs and improve the experience through UX testing.  
I originally wanted to release it for free, but a some people suggested a tiny one-time price (€1–3). I’m a bit ashamed to say that now my greedy little brain is considering it, although I’d probably need a publisher to handle the business side. Still figuring that part out!

Anyway, I’d love to hear what you think, especially about the concept and the whole AI-assisted development process.  
Thanks for taking a look!  
**PS:** The beta is currently iOS-only (Android coming soon). Feel free to DM me if you’d like to try it!  
**PS2**: I’ll put some “gameplay” videos in the comments..
